race.title: Matchbook 50/50 Series Mares Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: BRICKFIELD BELLE ticks plenty of boxes and can open her hurdles account at the third attempt. Viva Laa Vida could make it a 1-2 for the yard, with debutant Rock On Suzie also considered. BRICKFIELD BELLE (IRE) VIVA LAA VIDA (IRE) ROCK ON SUZIE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Brickfield Belle (1/1), Rock On Suzie (4/1), Viva Laa Vida (11/2), Birdie Conway (6/1), Dedudefromhouston (14/1), Affiniseaandbeyond (20/1), Sapphire Jewel (33/1), Easter Snow (33/1), Gotawinnerinyou (33/1), A Chairde Go Leir (50/1), Hee Hiles (50/1)

past_results.ride_description: Prominent, tracked leaders after 1st, 3rd halfway, 2nd when slight mistake 3 out, led approaching straight, pushed along 2 out where jumped left and slipped on landing, joined when jumped left last, ridden and headed final 100 yards, no impression, kept on one pace
Close up, 2nd halfway, took closer order under 4f out, travelled well to lead over 2f out, asserted over 1f out, kept on well final furlong, eased close home, easily
Tracked leaders, 4th halfway, pushed along entering straight, led briefly over 1f out, soon headed and no extra in 3rd 1f out, kept on one pace inside final furlong
Mid-division, pushed along in moderate 6th entering straight, mistake 2 out, no impression on leaders
